The Best Burger and more!
Apr 2025 • Family
If you find yourself in Ho Chi Min just wanting a good ole burger then you can’t miss Marcel - Calmette Burger. In fact, you just shouldn’t miss this place period. It’s just THAT GOOD. You can get a great smash burger or there are quite a number of options with a gourmet French twist. I love my burgers and this place is high up on my list of great burger restaurants. They also served great French fries and delicious desserts like creme brûlée, creamy cheesecake with raspberry sauce and brownies. The place itself is very cute and inviting. The hostess and cashier girls were so welcoming and helpful they made the whole experience that much more enjoyable. My family and I ate here twice and If I lived in Ho Chi Minh, I would be a regular here.
